stages.report:
FALSIFIED
The belief that a golden cross on DOGE/USDT means a month of gains is falsified on past data because it did not beat the pre-registered random-entry benchmark.

**What was tested**
The rule: when 20-day SMA crosses above 50-day SMA on DOGE/USDT, buy at next day's open and sell at close 21 trading days later, long. Window 2019-07-05 to 2026-10-29. Criterion: mean_net_return beats random_entries at alpha 0.05 with min_trades 20. Backtest produced 26 signals, 26 trades, mean_net 21.97%, median_net 6.22%, win_rate 65.38%, total_net 687.60%, avg_bars_held 21.0, exposure 20.42%.

**Strongest evidence against**
Random-entry baseline: rule mean 21.97% vs random-entry mean 10.03%; rule beat 83% of 2000 random sets, one-sided p = 0.173. Required p < 0.050. Primary test failed.

**What held up**
Sample size pass: 26 completed trades. Look-ahead guard pass. Multiple testing pass: first sealed belief, no correction needed. Fees pass: mean stays 21.60% at 0.25% per side. Time split pass: positive in both halves 42.99% (n=12) then 3.94% (n=14). Neighbourhood pass: 6 of 6 nearby variants point same way, median 17.41%. Cross-asset pass: beats random entries on 6 of 9 other assets.

**What would change the verdict**
A one-sided p-value below 0.050 for mean_net_return vs random entries with at least 20 trades.

**Caveats**
Versus just holding: rule compounded 687.6% while buy-and-hold over same window returned 1844.9% with 20% exposure. Falsify tests beliefs about the past. It is not investment advice and makes no prediction.
